title: BuildRequest
description: What a builder reads to build the slice: the slice, its worktree, the practices and what it declared.

folder.description: The slice's worktree, relative to the project, as worktrees.cut made it, such as .forge/worktrees/TR2.

practices.description: The practices files a builder reads before it writes, relative to the project, from forge's settings.

rules.description: The rules of the committed design that the slice's actions apply: write each as a pure function named in camelCase after the rule, taking and giving those values, and the thin function around it that reads and writes what its action names. Empty when there is none.
